tagline: Print a little card with your WiFi name, password and a QR code.
description:
Type the network name and the password. A card appears with a code a phone can point at. Print it, tape it to the fridge, keep it in a wallet, or just hold the screen up for a guest. The details stay on this device.

The last card you typed comes back the next time you open the app. Press Invite (the GifOS bar) if you want the same card to show up for everyone in a meeting. They can point a phone at it too.

An unofficial port of wifi-card by bndw. Same kind of card: network name, password, and a code that logs a phone in.
